data.name: Zoollision
data.detailed_description:
About This Game

Zoollision is a zoo-themed multiplayer party action game where you control animal balls in a colorful cartoon world. Jump between physics-based battles, item-driven racing, and long-term roster progression. Matches are fast, but your choices matter: which animals you specialize in, which mode you master, and which zoo zones you unlock first.

Modes (Live + In Development)

  • Collision (2 players, 1v1): A turn-based physics duel. Each player brings 3 animal balls, aims, launches, and fights to knock opponents out or control territory.

  • Race (2-6 players): A chaotic race mode with item boxes, speed tools, shields, projectiles, and traps. Combine item timing with animal ball skills to secure better finishes.

  • PartyRun (6 players, 3v3, coming soon): A team mini-game gauntlet featuring bowling domino, soccer, curling, basketball, and sumo-ball style rounds planned for a future update.

Core Challenges and Highlights

  • Two Collision rule sets: switch between survival elimination and territory control; survival also adds day-night pressure and night fog tension.

  • Race Cheer system: predict finishing bands before the race using daily free Cheer for extra excitement and spectator-style engagement, without directly spending coins.

  • Meaningful animal differences: animal balls are not just skins; they use distinct stats and skill profiles across modes.

Zoo Collection and Progression

Your main menu is built around an expandable zoo structure:

  • Unlock animal balls by browsing themed zoo zones.

  • Buy hats and cosmetics to personalize your look.

  • Interact with keepers, complete daily/weekly goals, and grow your currency flow.

  • Level up through XP-based progression and earn milestone rewards over time.

Multiplayer on Steam

  • Supports quick play, hosted lobbies, server browser, and friend invites on Steam.

  • Race supports 2-6 players, while Collision is a focused 1v1 competitive format.

  • AI fill is available to help start matches or practice setups.

Session Length and Play Style

Whether you want quick sub-10-minute rounds or longer back-to-back sessions for unlocking and progression, Zoollision is built for replayable party sessions with friends. The depth comes from animal picks, mode knowledge, and execution under pressure.

Art Direction

Zoollision blends playful, high-readability cartoon visuals with a warm zoo atmosphere, combining expressive animal designs, themed regions, and keeper personalities into a lively party-game identity.
